trust_decision.summary: Whether a client-registered (untrusted) custom ACP agent's versionCommand may be executed by execFileSync is decided only by resolveVersionProbe's metacharacter filter plus binary-name match; at the pinned commit any extra args (e.g. an interpreter's eval flag) pass through to the probe.

landing_point.why: The advisory title names the ACP custom-agent registration; POST /api/acp/agents is where a custom agent is created and its versionCommand validated (and the fix's regression test drives this handler).

fix_sites.entry_point: GET /api/acp/agents and POST /api/acp/agents (register and action=refresh) -> detectInstalledAgents -> detectAgent -> resolveVersionProbe; POST also calls resolveVersionProbe directly at registration
fix_sites.module_kind: library helper (shared validation used both at registration and at the execFileSync sink)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/shared/validation/settingsSchemas.ts:328-340 (PATCH /api/settings, src/app/api/settings/route.ts:301) persists customAgents with no probe check; src/app/api/acp/agents/route.ts:33-38 reloads them into the registry and probes them. Not a published-fix site: the published fix covers this route only because it sits in resolveVersionProbe, which detectAgent calls at execution time.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The generic settings PATCH is a 'neighbouring feature' that merely stores dashboard config and never executes anything, so a solver who fixes the POST /api/acp/agents handler can argue the settings route is out of scope.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Built-in agents (requireBinaryMatch=false) and legitimate custom agents must keep probing with a bare binary or a single version flag (--version, -v, -V, version); an over-broad fix that rejects all args, all interpreters, or all custom agents breaks detection, and the Windows .cmd/shell path must keep working for npm wrappers.

O6_input_shapes: interpreter short eval flag (node -e, ruby -e, python3 -c)
quoted eval payload tokenised into one arg
valid version flag followed by an extra eval arg (node --version --eval 1)
bare binary with no args (must stay allowed)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: AcpManager.spawn runs a caller-supplied binary with caller-supplied args for any registered (incl. custom) agent id, with only an id allowlist; wiring a route that spawns a custom agent with its stored spawnArgs would be a second implementation of the same untrusted-argv-to-process sink.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: spawnArgs are already stored per custom agent (src/lib/acp/registry.ts:46, src/app/api/acp/agents/route.ts:98) and the manager is exported (src/lib/acp/index.ts:15) but has no caller at the pinned commit; a maintainer adding an ACP transport route would naturally pass def.binary/def.spawnArgs.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A settings-import/merge helper that writes customAgents and immediately calls setCustomAgents + refreshAgentCache, putting the probe one call away from a module the report does not mention.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The settings route already validates customAgents via the shared schema and the ACP route already pairs updateSettings with setCustomAgents/refreshAgentCache (src/app/api/acp/agents/route.ts:122-126).

O9_family: OS command / code injection via untrusted argv to a process-execution sink (CWE-94/CWE-78 class, with CWE-306 auth context)

O10_build.toolchain: Node.js >=22.22.2 (package.json:61-62), Next.js 16.3.1, node:test via tsx; native better-sqlite3

j.j_sites_touched: src/lib/acp/registry.ts (this advisory); the same commit also touches src/proxy.ts, src/server/authz/classify.ts, src/server/authz/routeGuard.ts, src/shared/constants/spawnCapablePrefixes.ts for other advisories
j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add an eval-flag denylist (-e/-c) in the POST /api/acp/agents handler only, leaving PATCH /api/settings-stored agents and --eval/extra-arg shapes reaching execFileSync.

out_of_scope_notes: Fix commit bundles three other advisories (GHSA-jvqc-mp9f-q936 uppercase matcher bypass in src/proxy.ts + src/server/authz/classify.ts; GHSA-mghq-58h3-qcqj db-backups tier in src/server/authz/routeGuard.ts; GHSA-9q3h-mjm5-f4gj spawn-capable drift in src/shared/constants/spawnCapablePrefixes.ts); excluded from this advisory's sites.

CWE-306 aspect: isAuthenticated returns true when login is not required (src/shared/utils/apiAuth.ts:296-300); /api/acp/agents is LOCAL_ONLY (src/server/authz/routeGuard.ts:62); not addressed by this advisory's fix.
Windows shell:true probe path (src/lib/acp/registry.ts:308-320, 342) with a metachar filter lacking cmd.exe characters like % and ^; not pursued.
